text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What's this, what's this!? A sudden surge 
of power just welled up inside me...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Goddesses, did ya wanna see my fiery 
running on top of my comedy routines?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll give it everything I've got! 
Just watch the run of the "Super White 
Lightning"!
